comment: Performance budgets of the samples (test/browser/perf.mjs, bench/README.md). One view per sample and quality tier, measured at a fixed drawing-buffer size: the size that tier renders on a 14-inch MacBook Pro (the city demos cap the desktop tier at a pixel ratio of 1.5, 2268x1473), 1280x720 for the mobile tier. `ms` is the frame budget on the reference machine class; the score is 100 x the geometric mean of ms budget / measured ms over every pose of every view (100 = on budget on average, higher is faster). The other keys are ceilings that are reported when exceeded. Budgets are goals and change only by a decision of the owner, never to make a run pass.

played.comment: The played-frame check (test/browser/played-frame.mjs, npm run check:full): rAF intervals of the production build in headless Chrome with vsync and the frame-rate limit off, desktop tier, at `size` and DPR 1, over `window` ms after `warm` ms of play. median / p95 in ms on the reference machine class; with the unpack getParameter stall (before the pixel-store shadow, src/core/PixelStoreShadow.js) both read a median of 15-16 ms.
